text: The free group functor Set → Grp is ___ adjoint to the forgetful functor Grp → Set.
explanation: Hom_Grp(F(S), G) ≅ Hom_Set(S, U(G)): a homomorphism out of a free group is freely determined by where the generators go. Free/forgetful pairs are the prototype of adjunctions, with 'free' always on the left.
